model: H.K.M. Главширпотреб Ленинградский граммофонный завод — portable wind-up патефон (78 rpm suitcase phonograph)

maker.name: Н.К.М. Главширпотреб, Ленинградский граммофонный завод
maker.src: Owner's in-hand reference photographs (lid interior maker decal, photos 5/13: 'Н.К.М. ГЛАВШИРПОТРЕБ / ЛЕНИНГРАДСКИЙ ГРАММОФОННЫЙ ЗАВОД', treble-clef + red CCCP flag in a diamond). Class corroborated by ПТ-3 catalog listings (cozythings.ru/shop/grammofonyi-patefonyi, galex.ru collection #27178) and ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/Патефон.

case.src: Owner's in-hand photographs (closed suitcase, photos 2/3/8 — near-square plan, ~2:1 width:height closed). Dimensional class per ПТ-3 portable патефон listings (case ≈ 290–310 mm square × 150–170 mm closed): cozythings.ru/shop/grammofonyi-patefonyi/patefon-dovoennyiy-leningrad/, galex.ru/about/collections/detail.php?ELEMENT_ID=27178.

lid.src: Owner's photographs (photos 1/2/8): hinged lid is roughly one third of the closed height (160 mm) → ≈55 mm shell; rear chrome piano-hinge (photo 2/10), opens back past vertical (photo 1).

platter.src: Owner's photographs (photos 1/9/11): chrome-rimmed turntable carrying a 10-inch disc with slight record overhang. Standard portable патефон platter ≈ 250 mm (10 in): ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/Патефон.

record.src: Owner's photograph of an Апрелевский завод shellac disc (photo 14: 'СССР / АПРЕЛЕВСКИЙ ЗАВОД', ГОСТ 5289-50). 78 rpm + 10-inch (250 mm) shellac standard: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Phonograph_record (coarse-groove 78 rpm, 10 in).

tonearm.src: Owner's photographs (photos 7/11): chromed S-curved swan-neck tonearm running from a circular base post to the reproducer over the platter; tube reads ≈20–24 mm across the bends, total run a bit over half the platter diameter.

reproducer.src: Owner's photographs (photos 7/11): circular soundbox (мембрана) with a 12-petal flower grille and a needle thumbscrew, ≈ a quarter of the platter diameter (250 mm).

crank.src: Owner's photographs (photos 1/8/9): fold-out L-shaped chromed winding crank with a black bakelite knob, socketed in the right face.

hardware.items: chrome carry handles recessed in front/side faces with black backing trays (photo 3); chrome corner caps + two front clasps/latches (photos 1/3/8); rear chrome piano-hinge (photo 2); nickel speed-regulator plate 'FH 78 Bremze' (photo 6); nickel auto-stop plate 'АВТОСТОП ВКЛ/ВЫКЛ' (photo 12); steel needle tin in a corner (photo 4)

finish.case: dark-brown granitol/leatherette over plywood, triangular-flake emboss (photos 3/12)
finish.metal: polished chrome/nickel hardware + tonearm + platter rim

derivation.note: DERIVED from facts above (mm→m): base height = closed 160 − lid 55 ≈ 105 mm; deck sits at the base top; platter radius = dia 250/2 = 125 mm, chrome rim slightly inside the record so record_r 125 > felt; turntable offset to the left of centre so the tonearm base + crank clear it on the right (per photos 1/9). Hinge at the rear top edge (z = −d/2).
derivation.src: geometric derivation from facts.case + facts.lid + facts.platter + facts.record
